title: Hold a licence to explore for or recover minerals in coastal waters
what: Explore for or recover minerals in NSW coastal waters only under a licence or special purpose consent.

sources.title: Offshore Minerals Act 1999 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not: (a) explore for minerals in coastal waters, or (b) recover minerals from coastal waters, unless the exploration or recovery is authorised by a licence or special purpose consent granted under this Act

administration.who: Minister administering the Offshore Minerals Act 1999 (NSW)

sources.title: Offshore Minerals Act 1999 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 63, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: the Minister may: (a) provisionally grant an exploration licence to the applicant, or (b) refuse the application.
